name: 万策
desc: Enterprise decision hub that turns scattered data into judgments
desc_zh: 把企业分散的数据和经验转成决策判断的中枢平台
solves: Reports pile up but judgment stays slow; this organises facts, signals and actions so a decision reaches the business.
solves_zh: 汇报很多、判断很慢，它把事实、信号和行动组织到一起，让经营判断更快落到业务链路里。
best_for: Preparing a quarterly review when the numbers exist but nobody agrees on the call.
best_for_zh: 开季度经营会前，数据都有但对结论没有把握，先用它把材料和数字理成一条线。
